PROFILE::httpcompression
       Returns the value of an HTTP compression profile setting.

SYNOPSIS
       PROFILE::httpcompression ATTR

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in an assigned HTTP compression profile.

RETURN VALUE
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in an assigned HTTP compression profile.

VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.0.0 --First introduced the command.
